questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer a, b, c, ans
Set a = 10, b = 20, c = 15
if((a < b) AND (b > c))
    Set ans = a + 10
else
    Set ans = b - 5
End if
Print ans
questions.explanation: Evaluate (a < b): (10 < 20) is True. Evaluate (b > c): (20 > 15) is True. Both AND evaluates to True. Branch taken yields 20.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer a, b, c, res
Set a = 5, b = 5, c = 10
if((a EQUALS b) OR (c > a + b))
    Set res = a * 2
else
    Set res = c - a
End if
Print res
questions.explanation: (a EQUALS b) is True. (c > a + b) is (10 > 10) = False. The OR condition is True. Result is 10.
